AI DELETE /actionitemTemplates/{id}: Assert 200 and that already-generated action items survive.
AI DELETE /actionitems/bulk: Multi-delete via query param. Assert all-or-nothing semantics, non-existent id handling, and that a subsequent search returns zero rows.
AI DELETE /actionitems/entity/{id}: Cascade delete for a source entity. Assert only the target entity's items are removed and sibling entities are untouched.
AI DELETE /attribute-config/values/{id}: Assert removal and behaviour when the value is referenced by an action item.
AI DELETE /attribute-config/{id}: Assert cascade to values and ui-field-config, and rejection when the attribute is in use.
AI DELETE /entity/{id}: Widest blast radius in the service. Assert cascade to action items, comments, templates and KPI maps; assert tenant isolation.
AI DELETE /kpi-config-attributes/{id}: Assert 200 and that the parent KPI remains valid.
AI DELETE /kpi/{kpiId}/entity/{entityId}: Un-map. Assert mapping removed but the KPI definition survives.
AI DELETE /playbook/{playbookName}: Cascades to all steps. Assert 204, that child action items are gone, and that live instances behave per spec.
AI DELETE /playbook/{playbookName}/actio: Assert all steps removed, playbook shell survives, subsequent GET returns empty array not 404.
Assert 204, remaining steps keep contiguous ordering, live instances unaffected.
AI DELETE /tenants/{tenantId}: Destructive - run only in an isolated throw-away tenant.
AI GET /actionitems/editor: Editor field metadata. Assert required query params enforced, field list, sequence and visibility flags per contextType.
AI GET /actionitems/filters: Filter metadata that powers the grid filter bar. Assert filter list matches the attribute config created in setup.
AI GET /actionitems/page/summary: Summary page config. Static metadata - smoke assertion on 200 + non-empty field list.
AI GET /actionitems/{entityId}/{id}: Entity-scoped fetch. Assert cross-entity id returns empty / 404 (tenant & entity isolation check).
AI GET /attribute-config: Assert seeded system attributes plus the custom one created in POST /attribute-config.
AI GET /comments: Assert scoping by entityId+entityType and missing-param 400.
AI GET /kpi/entities/{id}: Assert configured KPI list per entity and tenant isolation.
AI GET /kpis: Assert list contains the KPI created in setup, with paging if applicable.
AI GET /kpis/{id}: Assert full-fidelity read-back including nested kpiConfigAttributes.
AI GET /page: Reference data for POST /ui-field-config. Assert known page ids exist.
AI GET /playbook/history: Archive read. Assert an archived instance appears with correct finalStatus and archivedOn; date-range and paging params.
AI GET /playbook/instances/{instanceId}/: Assert instance snapshot reflects step statuses set by PUT /playbook/instances/{instanceId}/action-items/{actionItemName} and is decoupled from later template edits.
AI GET /playbook/{playbookName}/action-i: Assert steps returned in displayOrder ascending and full field fidelity vs. create payload.
AI GET /playbook/{playbookName}/instance: User-scoped instance items. Assert filtering by userId and that other users' items are excluded.
AI GET /playbooks: Manage-playbooks list. Assert default sort (dueDate,createdOn,updatedOn asc), type filter, page/pageSize, total count.
AI GET /tenant: Auto-provisions the tenant on first call. Assert lazy-create behaviour and idempotency on second call.
AI GET /ui-component: Reference data for POST /ui-field-config. Assert known component ids exist.
AI GET /users: Assignee picker feed. Assert non-empty list and that assignees used in AI tests are present.
AI GET /users/info: Assert identity fields match the bearer token; 401 without token.
AI PATCH /entity/attribute: Assert attribute value update reflects on subsequent action-item reads.
AI POST /actionitemTemplates: Prerequisite for POST /actionitems/bulk. Assert 201, ids list persisted, empty-ids 400, duplicate-name behaviour.
AI POST /actionitems/bulk: Creates N action items from a template. Assert count created equals template item count, attribute inheritance, partial-failure response, invalid templateId 400/404.
AI POST /attribute-config: Creates a custom attribute. Assert 201, isCustom default, duplicate name rejection, and that it surfaces in /actionitems/editor.
AI POST /attribute-config/values: Adds a picklist value. Assert isDefault / isEditorDefault exclusivity and sequence ordering.
AI POST /channel: Assert channel id returned, userIds invited, autoAcceptInvitations honoured, blank name/description 400.
AI POST /comments: Assert 201, channelId required (36-char cap), parent/child threading.
AI POST /entity: Prerequisite for every other flow. Assert 201, generated entityId, nested sourceAttributes persisted, size-limit 400s.
AI POST /kpi-config-attributes: Defines the KPI computation rule. Assert persisted attrValue, size-limit 400s, and that POST /kpi/entities output changes accordingly.
AI POST /kpi/entities: Computes the dashboard KPI tiles. Assert counts change correctly after creating/closing action items, and that queryMap / attributeValues filters are applied.
AI POST /kpi/entity: Single KPI->entity mapping. Assert 201 and appearance in GET /kpi/entities/{id}.
AI POST /kpi/map/entities: Bulk map one KPI to many entities. Assert every entity gets the mapping and duplicates are idempotent.
AI POST /playbook: Root of the whole feature. Assert 201, generated name slug, RECURRING vs AD_HOC validation, duplicate-name rejection, RBAC 403 without lsnop.edit.
AI POST /playbook/recurring/initiate: Batch trigger for all recurring playbooks in a process. Assert returned count, idempotency on re-run, AD_HOC playbooks excluded.
AI POST /playbook/search: Assert each filter (name, status, type, duration, visibility=ASSIGNED_TO_ME / CREATED_BY_ME), null-status excludes CANCELLED+COMPLETED, sorting and paging.
AI POST /playbook/search/grouped: Assert grouping key = playbookName + dueDate, assignee aggregation per group, and parity of the group set with POST /playbook/search for the same filter.
AI POST /playbook/{playbookName}/action-: Step definition. Assert 201, displayOrder honoured, savedFilter and linkedProcedure round-trip, blank displayName 400.
AI POST /playbook/{playbookName}/initiat: Creates a runnable instance. Assert 201, instance id generated, one instance-item per template step, dueDate propagation, assignee fan-out, notification side-effect.
AI POST /searchActionItems: Primary grid feed. Assert pagination (pageNumber/pageSize), sort order, each filter key, empty-result shape, and that the embedded UI config block is returned.
AI POST /ui-field-config: Places an attribute on a page/component. Assert sequence, groupId, isVisible, and effect on the editor/filter/summary endpoints.
AI PUT /actionitems/status: Bulk status transition used by the grid. Assert returned id list, updateEndDate flag behaviour, invalid status enum rejection, mixed valid/invalid id list.
AI PUT /actionitems/{id}/extend: Due-date extension. Assert new dueDate delta, behaviour on already-closed items, and 404 on unknown id.
AI PUT /attribute-config/values/{id}: Assert value rename propagates to displayValue on existing action items.
AI PUT /attribute-config/{id}: Assert title/description update and isEnabled=false removes it from editor config.
AI PUT /kpi-config-attributes/{id}: Assert rule change is reflected in the next POST /kpi/entities call.
AI PUT /kpis/{id}: Assert displayName/description update, isActive=false hides the KPI from POST /kpi/entities output.
AI PUT /playbook/instances/{instanceId}/: Bulk tick-off. Assert every step flips, instance completes, and repeat call is idempotent.
Core execution tick-off. Assert actioned=true/false toggling, instance roll-up status change when the last step is actioned.
AI PUT /playbook/{playbookName}: Assert partial update semantics, assignee list replacement, type switch AD_HOC->RECURRING, 404 on unknown playbook.
AI PUT /playbook/{playbookName}/action-i: Assert reorder via displayOrder, targetView change, 404 on unknown step.
AI PUT /ui-field-config/{id}: Assert re-sequencing changes editor field order.
LM GET /views: View catalogue read. Neither UI calls it (JMeter LM coverage scan, 2026-09-23).
LM POST /exportData: Exercised only indirectly through PO /exportData. Since SM-33313 (2026-09-24) the export carries reason codes for entity-view-procedure rows; assert them directly.
LM POST /importData: Exercised only indirectly through PO /importData during migration. The LM-native contract (reason codes for entity-view-procedure rows, SM-33313) is not asserted.
LM POST /validate: Asynchronous ALM entity validation. Returns a job; poll GET /job/validation/{task_id}. Migration/Test_007 covers the ALM-platform validation API, not this LM route.
LM POST /views: Register views in the catalogue. Neither UI calls it (JMeter LM coverage scan, 2026-09-23).
PO DELETE /process/{processName}/subproc: Delete a subprocess. Must correctly re-link transitions of siblings - classic orphan-node defect.
PO DELETE /process/{process_name}/transi: Delete a node's transitions. Must not orphan downstream nodes.
Delete the whole hierarchy. Destructive - needs an explicit guard test.
PO DELETE /template/{templateName}/type/: Delete template; must fail when processes still reference it.
PO GET /calendar: Paged list of all calendars. Pagination + sort correctness is unverified; UI calendar picker depends on it.
PO GET /calendar/{calendarName}/cycle: Paged list of cycles in a calendar. Postman shows a known negative (pageSize=-1) that is not automated.
PO GET /job/{jobId}/status: Generic async job poller (role assignment, publish, validation). Used by many flows.
PO GET /meter/{entityType}/{entityOperat: Entity-limit metering read used by planning-mfe before scenario creation. Pair with GET /quota for the limit.
PO GET /process: Paged/filtered process list. Backs the process cockpit landing page.
PO GET /process/id/{processId}: Resolve process name by id. Used by cross-service callbacks.
PO GET /process/name/{displayName}: Resolve internal names by display name (duplicate-display-name behaviour untested).
PO GET /process/{processName}/children: Immediate subprocesses. Used for lazy-loaded navigation.
PO GET /process/{processName}/context: Resolved planning context (model, scope, cycle) consumed by Planning Space drill-through.
PO GET /process/{processName}/processGan: Gantt payload (flat). Large-response contract, easy to break.
Gantt + hierarchy in one call. Primary cockpit render call.
PO GET /process/{processName}/subprocess: Read a subprocess. Baseline for every other subprocess assertion.
Valid referenceNodeName candidates. Drives the UI dropdown; wrong list = invalid schedules.
PO GET /process/{processName}/tree: Full hierarchy of the process. Any tree-shape regression breaks the Gantt and cockpit.
PO GET /process/{processName}/users: Users resolved through role policies on the process.
PO GET /process/{process_name}/transitio: Read the resulting graph. The single best assertion target for graph correctness.
PO GET /quota/{entityType}/{entityOperat: Read a single quota value; must fall back to default when unset.
PO GET /supplyChainAction/{id}: Read one SCA including uiConfig JSON blob (escaping bugs live here).
PO GET /template/Id/{templateId}: Template lookup by id, called by planning-mfe when it resolves a process template.
PO GET /template/schema/type/{templateTy: JSON schema for the template type - ideal source for contract assertions.
PO GET /template/{templateName}/type/{te: Template entities (attributes/UI config) for a template, called by planning-mfe.
PO GET /tenant/onboard/status: Per-step boolean matrix of onboarding progress.
PO POST /configuration/exchange/deploy: Deploy from the BY Exchange. Cross-realm blast radius.
PO POST /configuration/exchange/publish: Publish to the BY Exchange. Async, job-status polled.
PO POST /configuration/publish: Publish PO configuration as an ALM artefact. Async.
PO POST /process: Create a process directly (not from template). The primary creation path; every downstream object hangs off it.
PO POST /process/import: Single-process import. Round-trip fidelity is unverified.
PO POST /process/search: Filtered search (cycle, status, owner). Filter combinations are completely unverified.
PO POST /process/status: Bulk status for a list of processes. Performance-sensitive (cockpit polls it).
PO POST /process/{processName}/actionite: Playbook-driven bulk creation. Partial-failure semantics untested.
Filtered/paged search. Backs the action-item grid; filter regressions are user-visible immediately.
PO POST /process/{processName}/attribute: Create a dynamic attribute. Attributes feed workflow filters & drill-through context.
PO POST /process/{processName}/eventActi: Bind an SCA/webhook to a node event (start/stop). This is how scenarios get created automatically.
PO POST /process/{processName}/subproces: Start a subprocess node; fires start event actions.
Stop a subprocess node; fires end event actions and auto-transitions.
PO POST /process/{processName}/validate/: Pre-flight check before creating a scenario/cluster. Defaults to isAsync=true, which writes a job row; send isAsync=false for a synchronous check (fans out to the simulation and assumptions services). Called by planning-mfe.
PO POST /process/{process_name}/calendar: Deletes and regenerates the schedule for the process and every referencing subprocess. Destructive-by-design.
PO POST /process/{process_name}/cycle/{c: Auto-generate the whole transition hierarchy for a cycle. Async -> returns a job id.
PO POST /quota: Create/update quota for a scope. Over-permissive quota = cost/perf incident.
PO POST /reporting/config: Register a SIGMA workspace. Validation: workspaceId non-empty, type must equal SIGMA.
PO POST /resources: RBAC resource lookup proxied to LIAM; called by planning-mfe for permission checks.
PO POST /supplyChainAction: Create an SCA (procedure + wizard UI config).
PO POST /template: Create a process/entity template. Templates are the seed for every customer process - a bad template is multiplied N times.
PO POST /tenant/onboard: Full tenant bootstrap (roles, calendar, solution area, filters). No current UI caller; run only against a throw-away realm.
PO POST /tenants/machineCreds: Store M2M credentials. Must assert secrets are never echoed back.
PO POST /tenants/snowflakeCreds: Store Snowflake credentials. Same secret-leak concern.
PO POST /user/onboard: Create default admin/planner roles & entities for a new user.
PO POST /users/roles/add: Assign roles to subjects/roles. Async job. Grants access to processes.
PO POST /users/roles/remove: Revoke. Failure to revoke is a data-exposure defect.
PO PUT /process/{processName}: Update process metadata / calendar-cycle association. High regression risk - can orphan schedules.
PO PUT /process/{processName}/calendarcy: Bulk reschedule of node dates within a cycle. Cascades to every subprocess; silent corruption if wrong.
PO PUT /process/{processName}/eventActio: Update payload / http method / auth-token flag.
PO PUT /process/{processName}/planstartd: Shift plan start date for a cycle. Date-arithmetic hot spot.
PO PUT /process/{processName}/report/fol: Bind a reporting workspace folder to the process.
PO PUT /process/{processName}/scope: Update planning scope. Wrong scope silently changes what planners see.
PO PUT /process/{processName}/subprocess: Update offsets, duration, sequence, transition types. Highest-churn write path in the service.
PO PUT /supplyChainAction/{id}: Update SCA. Must not break existing event-action bindings.
PO PUT /tenant/onboard/status: Manually mark a step complete (recovery path).
UIF GET /filter-config: Filter metadata for a page. Not referenced by lui source as a literal; confirm the caller before prioritising.
UIF GET /page/filter: Process filter page config used by lui listing filters (page 21).
